description: This file defines the BestSellers widget, a stateless Flutter widget that displays a list of best-selling products in a horizontal list view. It uses external components like ProductCard and product models, and handles navigation to a product details screen.

classes.name: BestSellers
classes.description: A Flutter stateless widget that renders a horizontally scrollable list of product cards for best-selling products.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the BestSellers widget, displaying a title and a horizontal list of ProductCard widgets.
